inspections.finding: The complete initial vav has one rounded low node attached below the shaft after a narrowing. Same-unit velo shows the clearer two-level sheva contour; the final shuruq vav in the target word shows an ordinary narrow terminal. Extra mass is present here but its lower group does not uniquely separate a merged sheva from a single node or heavy terminal. Retain without claiming source absence.

The pe lower mass expands beneath its ordinary baseline but the small bottom notch alone does not establish a horizontal pair. Same-page ordinary pe fixes the letter foot; literal pe sheva, horizontal-pair and bar/stem controls still allow differently merged points beneath this opaque base. Retain rather than infer a class from the expected word.

Two lower nodes sit at the same level below the gimel foot, with a deep central white separation rising between them. The same-page yagen gimel-tsere has the same paired lower structure and the same attachment to the left foot; the same-page kerega gimel-patah instead has a continuous flat bar across its lower edge. Literal gimel segol has a separate third lower node, and the qamats control has a descending stem. The target preserves the horizontal pair without either lower extension. Certify B5 from the full contour and literal controls, preserving all prior scalars and the unusual preceding lamed B0/BC order.

The bet has one broad opaque lower mass joined to its baseline. The same-unit bet hiriq, bet sheva and literal bet tsere controls show distinct single/vertical/horizontal classes, but those divisions are not uniquely readable in the target. A compressed multi-dot group or single lower node still competes. Retain the exact vowel disclosure.
